title: Wider
about: Episode 10, 25 s, the hook to pull viewers to the series. One rule: every cut, the smile is wider; it ends so wide it flatlines. Built around Wan's weak spots: the widening happens in the EDIT (each shot starts wider than the last) not inside a shot; three takes of each risky 14B shot, best picked from contact sheets; the egg's blink added in post (assets/egg-blink.mp4, Wan would not blink it) and the flatline drawn in code (assets/flatline.mp4, Wan kept drawing heartbeats). Unsettling, never graphic. Silent for the user's own music; only the last line is written.
